code='''def regions(g):
    bg=g[0][0]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            stack=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop(); cells.append((r,c))
                for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and g[nr][nc]!=bg:
                        seen[nr][nc]=True; stack.append((nr,nc))
            out.append(cells)
    return out

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    for cells in regions(g):
        colors={g[r][c] for r,c in cells if g[r][c]!=0}
        if not colors: continue
        col=colors.pop()
        pat_cells={(r,c) for r,c in cells if g[r][c]==col}
        pr0=min(r for r,c in pat_cells); pc0=min(c for r,c in pat_cells)
        ph=max(r for r,c in pat_cells)-pr0+1; pw=max(c for r,c in pat_cells)-pc0+1
        pat=[[0]*pw for _ in range(ph)]
        for r,c in pat_cells: pat[r-pr0][c-pc0]=col
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
            for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
                g[r][c]=pat[(r-pr0)%ph][(c-pc0)%pw]
    return g
'''
